name: War Inc: Rising Merge and Evolution Guide — Forge Stones Strategy
title: War Inc: Rising Merge and Evolution Guide — Level Up Your Heroes
meta_description: Master hero merging and evolution in War Inc: Rising. Complete guide to merge levels, Forge Stones, evolution costs, and when to upgrade your heroes for maximum value.
author: Klown Kollege

sections.heading: The Short Version
sections.content:
Merge levels increase base stats and unlock new skill tiers. Merge 6 is the first major power spike. Merge 12 is max. Focus your Forge Stones on 3-5 core heroes — one level 8 hero is worth more than eight level 5 heroes. Never merge your last deployable copy of a hero you use.

Here's everything about the merge system, Forge Stone economy, and when to push vs when to wait.

sections.heading: Merge Levels Explained
sections.content:
Each merge level requires copies of the same hero plus Forge Stones (from level 6 onward). The stats increase per level, and certain levels unlock new skill tiers.

- Level 6: First major power spike for most heroes. Skill upgrades unlock.
- Level 7: Trigger Master passive unlocks. Also gives 100-gem Power Stance achievement.
- Level 12: Maximum. Strongest version of every skill.

Focus on getting your core team to 6 first before spreading resources to backups.

sections.heading: Forge Stones: The Real Bottleneck
sections.content:
Forge Stones are required from Merge 6 onwards. They're the most scarce resource in the game. Here's where to get them:
- Hunting mode rewards (best consistent source)
- Infinite War
- Daily chests
- Event shops

Never spend Forge Stones on heroes you don't regularly use. The biggest mistake is spreading them across 10+ heroes instead of focusing on 3-5 core units. Pick your team and commit.

sections.heading: When to Merge vs When to Wait
sections.content:
Merging consumes copies of the hero, temporarily reducing your roster. Plan accordingly:

- Merge between sessions when you won't need full strength for 12-24 hours
- Never merge your last deployable copy of a hero you actively use
- Save major merges for after daily missions and Arena placements
- Higher-rarity heroes cost more but gain more per level

Use the evolution calculator tool on this site to plan which hero to upgrade next based on your available resources.
